d:
Sardiyon men sardi-jukam aur phlu ke mamle barhne lagte hain. lekin donon men kya phark hai aur phlu kitna khatarnak ho sakta hai? chhote bachchon, buzurgon aur pahle se bimar logon ke lie phlu ganbhir sabit ho sakta hai. aise men phlu vaiksin bimari ki ganbhirta aur aspatal men bharti hone ka jokhim kam kar sakti hai. lekin bharat men kin logon ko yah vaiksin lagvani chahie? kya yah har sal lagvana zaruri hai? iske said ifekt kya hain aur vaiksin kitni suraksha deti hai? janie is eksaplenar men.
